plainTranslation: Their Venus in your 5th house is romance, pleasure, delight, and creative spark. This is one of the sweetest overlays for dating and being enjoyed. Keep asking whether the bond can also support responsibility and repair.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
